name: Meeting Brief Agent
summary: Sends a Slack brief before each calendar meeting containing attendee email context, agenda summaries, and talking points.

items.title: Calendar integration
items.description: Reads upcoming meetings from your calendar to trigger briefs.
items.proved_when: The app successfully fetches upcoming calendar events.
items.source_quote: Before each meeting on my calendar

items.title: Slack brief delivery
items.description: Sends the generated meeting brief directly to you on Slack.
items.proved_when: A message appears in Slack with the complete brief.

items.title: Last email thread
items.description: Finds the most recent email thread with each meeting attendee.
items.proved_when: The latest email exchange with an attendee is successfully retrieved.

items.title: Agenda summariser
items.description: Reads attached PDF agendas from calendar invites and summarises them.
items.proved_when: A clear summary of the attached PDF agenda is produced.
items.source_quote: a summary of any attached agenda PDF

items.title: Talking points generator
items.description: Generates three relevant talking points based on emails and agenda.
items.proved_when: Three tailored talking points are included in the output.

items.title: Pre-meeting scheduler
items.description: Triggers the brief creation process before each meeting starts.
items.proved_when: The brief arrives before the scheduled meeting time.
items.source_quote: Before each meeting on my calendar

questions.text: Which Slack workspace should this post to?
How far in advance of each meeting should the brief be sent?

not_in_this_version.title: CRM context lookup
not_in_this_version.reason: Not requested in the prompt, focusing purely on emails, PDFs, and talking points.
